# Eleene - independent creative studio (eleene.me)

> Eleene is Elina's independent, founder-led creative studio: cinematic product campaigns, brand films, websites and mobile apps, with one considered creative direction from first impression to launch. AI-assisted production is part of how images and films are made; concept, art direction, editing and finishing are done by Elina. Work ranges from realistic and minimal to editorial, cinematic and imaginative. Tagline: "Not made to blend in. Made to be remembered."

Last updated: 2026-11-17
Canonical site: https://eleene.me/ (also served at https://elinahovakimyan.com/)
Founder: Elina - creative technologist and visual storyteller, with 8+ years building digital products (40+ apps shipped, 5,500+ students taught)
Contact: enquiry form at https://eleene.me/#contact or Instagram https://www.instagram.com/eleene.ai/

## Services (by commission)

1. Product & campaign visuals - product hero images, lifestyle scenes, editorial collections and launch assets.
2. Cinematic films - product films, collection teasers, brand stories and short social edits.
3. Websites - brand websites, launch pages, product showcases and portfolios; designed, developed and launched.
4. Mobile apps - scoped MVPs, customer-facing apps and improvements to existing products, for iOS and Android.

Services can be commissioned individually or together as one coordinated project (for example campaign images, a short film and a launch page under one creative direction and one proposal). Pricing is not published; each project begins with a proposal covering deliverables, timeline, revisions and pricing.

## Who it suits

Focus areas: independent lighting and premium home-decor brands; perfume and home-fragrance brands; bridal and occasionwear designers. Other brands with a product to show are welcome.

## Portfolio (on the homepage)

- Halo - product campaign, lighting & interiors: one rose-marble table lamp shown in seven settings with attention to its form, material and the way it holds light. Independent concept.
- Ivory, in bloom - bridal editorial in a glasshouse with fabric and silhouette continuity (7 images). Independent concept.
- Atelier - 14-second bridal film following a gown from sketch to greenhouse. Independent concept.
- Rouge - fashion editorial: one red gown across seven settings, with wardrobe and character consistency. Independent concept.
- Source - spec campaign for a mineral water product, not commissioned by the brand.
- Quiet Hours - naturalistic, lamp-lit lifestyle imagery.
- The Screening Room - films including Atelier, The House on the Cliff, Free Fall, and the original micro-drama series Double Booked.

## Websites & apps (https://eleene.me/websites-apps.html)

- Evoria (https://evoria.io) - website for a marketplace where families book children's and family celebrations; vendors manage requests in the Evoria Planning app (App Store, Armenia: https://apps.apple.com/am/app/evoria-planning/id6769776875). Design & development.
- Aybora (https://aybora.app) - content planner for social media: capture ideas, tag them, plan on a calendar and track posts from idea to published. Website and iPhone app (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/aybora-ai-content-planner/id6810120480). Design & development.
- Eleene - this studio website (personal project, 2026).
- Apps built for iPhone & Android: Evoria Planning (2026), Culinar - recipes, weekly menu and grocery list (2024, https://apps.apple.com/us/app/culinar-meal-planner/id6523429156), Travio - trip planning & maps (2022), Prehab101 - guided recovery (2020), Casana - Spanish-language wellbeing (2019).

## Learn (https://eleene.me/learn.html)

Teaching is separate from client work. Building websites & apps with AI: React Native and React courses on Udemy (https://www.udemy.com/user/elina-hovakimyan/) and application-based 1:1 build training. AI visuals & cinematic storytelling: lessons in preparation; interest list open.

## Process

1. The first spark (brief). 2. Finding the direction (vision and scope agreed). 3. Making it real (design, direction, build, milestones). 4. Out into the world (delivery or launch, handover agreed). After an enquiry, Elina reviews the brief and replies with questions, suggested next steps, and a proposal when the scope is clear.

## FAQ highlights

- Product accuracy is a priority; work is based on reference images and brand guidelines. If exact reproduction is essential, the production method is agreed first.
- A physical shoot is not always needed; it depends on accuracy, direction and deliverables.
- Usage and licensing are clarified in each project agreement.
- Projects can be run remotely and internationally.
